LAHORE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
LAHORE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance further to amend the
Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 25th July, 1997]
No. Legis.3(XXVI)/97, dated 25‑7‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby
published for general information:‑‑‑
And whereas the Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab is not in session and the Governor of the Punjab is
satisfied that immediate action is necessary;
Now, therefore, the Governor of
the Punjab in exercise of his powers under Article 128 of the Constitution, is
pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the Lahore
Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 4-A of Act XXX of 1975

LAHORE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
LAHORE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance further to amend the
Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 25th July, 1997]
No. Legis.3(XXVI)/97, dated 25‑7‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby
published for general information:‑‑‑
And whereas the Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab is not in session and the Governor of the Punjab is
satisfied that immediate action is necessary;
Now, therefore, the Governor of
the Punjab in exercise of his powers under Article 128 of the Constitution, is
pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 4‑A
of Act XXX of 1975.‑‑In the Lahore Development Authority Act,
1975 (XXX of 1975) hereinafter referred to as the said Act for section 4‑A,
the following shall be substituted:‑‑
"4‑A.
Vice‑Chairman.‑‑(1) The Government may designate from amongst
the members not more than two Vice‑Chairmen of the Authority.
(2) A Vice‑Chairman
shall perform such functions as may be assigned to him by the Authority.".

Amendment of section 7 of Act XXX of 1975

LAHORE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance further to amend the
Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 25th July, 1997]
No. Legis.3(XXVI)/97, dated 25‑7‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby
published for general information:‑‑‑
And whereas the Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab is not in session and the Governor of the Punjab is
satisfied that immediate action is necessary;
Now, therefore, the Governor of
the Punjab in exercise of his powers under Article 128 of the Constitution, is
pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:‑‑
3. Amendment of section 7 of
Act XXX of 1975.‑‑In the said Act, in section 7, for subsection
(2) the following shall be substituted:‑‑
"(2) The meetings of the
Authority shall be presided over by‑‑‑
(i) the Chairman;
(ii) in the absence of the
Chairman by the Vice‑Chairman;
(iii) in case there are more than
one Vice‑Chairmen, in accordance with such priority as may be determined
by the Authority; and
(iv) in the absence of the
Chairman as well as the Vice‑Chairman, by a member of the Authority
elected for the purpose by the members present, from amongst themselves.".
